body.message:
Good morning Mattia,

We will be happy to hold the unit for you for 1 hour and send you the booking confirmation during this time.

You may then proceed with the deposit payment and share the payment confirmation with us once completed. Kindly note that if we do not receive the payment confirmation within the given time, we will need to release the unit and reopen the calendar for other bookings.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
